sams.strength: The average person experiences significant public speaking discomfort, but you don't.
sams.gap: Public speaking nerves and discomfort are affecting your speaking performance.

phantasia.strength: You can speak using categories, rules, images and imagination to prompt you.
phantasia.gap: You need to develop your ability to think and speak under pressure & unfamiliar situations.

vocal.strength: You can speak fast, slow, loud or quiet on command under pressure.
vocal.gap: You need to practice speaking fast, slow, loud or quiet on command under pressure.

visual.strength: You can think and speak deliberately using images and imagination to prompt you.
visual.gap: You need to practice thinking and speaking using images and imagination to prompt you.

repeat.strength: You can speak well while complying with lots of rules restricting your responses.
repeat.gap: You need to develop your speaking identify by mastering a set of speaking rules unique to you.
